title: Why paying off your mortgage early is not obviously right
description:
Clearing debt early feels correct. The maths is a trade, not a rule. Here is both sides.

New video every day.

scenes.say: Paying off your mortgage early feels like the obviously correct thing to do. It is not obvious. It is a trade.
Every extra payment buys you a guaranteed return equal to your interest rate. Pay down a four percent mortgage, and you have earned a certain four percent.
The same money invested might earn more. Might. That word is doing a lot of work.
So the real question is not which number is bigger. It is which you need more: the higher expected return, or the certainty.
Someone who sleeps badly with debt is buying something real with that extra payment. It just is not measured in percent.
There is no universal answer here. There is only your rate, your options and your nerves.
